comment: Stage 1 requirements: the Owner measures progress by requirements closed, not by issues or PRs (Owner, 2026-10-28; agents/program.md 0.4). Library features come from tools/catalog.py (one per algorithm); each is done when it behaves as libwebrtc M157: ported faithfully from compare/webrtc/reference/, its defaults equal libwebrtc's, and no open item labelled req:<id> remains (so no parity gap it owns is open). Status: unassessed | open | in-progress | done. The Coordinator keeps it current; tools/requirements_report.py reports it. Fields: start / end (YYYY-MM-DD; end with a leading ~ is planned), depends_on (requirement ids that must be done first), cost (the Coordinator's estimate in Fixer runs, e.g. "4 runs"). The dashboard fills a blank start from the first req:<id> item and shows merged PRs as the actual cost. Each requirement carries `acceptance` (what must be true for it to be done), `verification` (what was checked against it, citing PRs, CI runs and tests) and `verified` (pass, partial or pending), first written by the Builder's window on 2026-10-29 at the Owner's request.
library_acceptance: Behaves as libwebrtc M157: (a) ported as a unit from compare/webrtc/reference/ (or a recorded, approved deviation), (b) defaults equal libwebrtc's, (c) no open item labelled req:<id>, so every parity gap it owns is closed or explained.

requirements.title: NACK + RTX retransmission
requirements.acceptance: (1) NackTracker ports modules/video_coding/nack_requester.cc and RtxSender ports modules/rtp_rtcp/source/rtp_packet_history.cc as units, including recovered_list_. (2) Defaults equal libwebrtc's: kMaxPacketAge 10000, kMaxNackPackets 1000, kMaxNackRetries 100 (no keyframe request), 20 ms kUpdateInterval, no min_retry_interval floor; history 600/9600, max(3xRTT, 1 s). (3) NackTracker.*, Rtx.*, E2E_NackRtx.* and E2E_RtpReceiver.NackAndRtxKeepFramesFlowingUnderRandomLoss pass. (4) No open req:F3.1 item.
requirements.evidence: `NackTracker` is libwebrtc's `NackRequester` (#23; kMaxPacketAge 10000, kMaxNackPackets 1000, 100 retries without a keyframe request, `ClearUpTo`, NACK on the revealing packet #435, 20 ms tick on its grid #518) and `RtxSender` is `RtpPacketHistory` (#76 group 2: stored at pacer send, 600/9600, max(3xRTT, 1 s), `VerifyRtt`, acked culling; early resend #217; payload padding #120); defaults match. Remaining: `recovered_list_` (the receiver passes no recovered flag, `src/rtp/rtp_receiver.cc:211`) and a 20 ms `min_retry_interval` floor libwebrtc lacks. Open: #411 (D2, D5/D6 NACK/RTX cells), #437 (late retransmissions at 100 kbps), #492 (repair path around the handover outage).
requirements.verification: Ported in #23, #76, #435, #518, #217, #120; NackTracker.* and Rtx.* (e.g. GivesUpAfter100RetriesWithoutKeyframeRequest, RetentionIsThreeRttWithOneSecondMinimumAndCullsAfterThreeTimesThat) pass. Missing: recovered_list_ (no recovered flag from rtp_receiver.cc), the 20 ms min_retry_interval default (nack_tracker.h:25) libwebrtc lacks; open #411, #437.

requirements.title: Keyframe requests (PLI/FIR) and loss notification
requirements.acceptance: (1) Receiver triggers match video/rtp_video_stream_receiver2.cc and video_receive_stream2.cc, including sequence-discontinuity re-request and missing video structure; sender filter matches video/encoder_rtcp_feedback.cc. (2) Defaults equal libwebrtc's: min_keyframe_request_interval 300 ms (kMinKeyframeSendIntervalMs), send_lntf false, decode time-out 200 ms/3 s/5 s. (3) KeyframeRequest.*, LibwebrtcDefaults.KeyframeRequestsAreFilteredFor300Ms and NoLossNotifications, E2E_Keyframe.RecoversFromUnrepairableLoss pass. (4) No open req:F3.5 item; video.keyframe_requests cells in band.
requirements.evidence: Receiver triggers ported from `RtpVideoStreamReceiver2`/`video_receive_stream2` (#23, PR #95, #335; v1 deleted in #167): first frame not a keyframe, NACK-list overflow, packet buffer cleared, IDR without parameter sets, decode time-out 200 ms / 3 s / 5 s; the sender's 300 ms `EncoderRtcpFeedback` filter (#151). Library defaults differ: `VideoSendControllerConfig::min_keyframe_request_interval` 0 (off; only the bench sets 300 ms) and `KeyframeRequestConfig::send_lntf` true (libwebrtc sends no LNTF for H.264; the bench turns it off). Not ported: sequence-discontinuity re-request, missing-video-structure trigger. Open: #480 (switches not at libwebrtc's default), #492 (keyframe path around the handover outage), #474 F3 (policer keyframe requests). #832 (#818): the sequence-discontinuity re-request (`UnwrapSequenceNumberOrRecover`, codecs other than H.264); PLI/FIR by `KeyframeRequestConfig::method` (kPli by default), with FIR sequence numbers from 1 as `RTCPSender::BuildFIR`. The missing-video-structure trigger is recorded as unreachable: there is no dependency descriptor extension.
requirements.verification: KeyframeRequest.*, LibwebrtcDefaults.KeyframeRequestsAreFilteredFor300Ms, NoLossNotifications and KeyframeRequestsArePli, and E2E_Keyframe.RecoversFromUnrepairableLoss pass. #832: Tester probe found no sev:1-2, baselines unchanged. Full CI on main 41033461980 shows no video.keyframe_requests gap. Parity 3.5 rows are ported or n/a. #818 closed; no open req:F3.5 item.

requirements.title: Video jitter estimation and render timing

Not ported, no effect on a one-to-one call: the per-`NetworkRoute` map (one route), RFC 8888 feedback (off by default in M157), `pending_untracked_size_` (the session numbers every packet), `ambiguous_receive_time` (unused by GoogCC M157).
